crossRefs.note: “Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to…
at noon, O king, I saw on the way a light from the sky, brighter than the sun, shining around me and those who traveled…
When we had all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you…
I, Daniel, alone saw the vision; for the men who were with me didn’t see the vision; but a great quaking fell on them…
Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.
Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.

translations.web: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.
translations.bsb: The men traveling with Saul stood there speechless. They heard the voice but did not see anyone.
translations.kjv: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
translations.asv: And the men that journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing the voice, but beholding no man.
